g.text: sparse-full-sparse-simd vs r85-hce-baseline-memory | 128 audited complete games | 10 opening-family clusters
Ply-cap draws / games — 10 ms: 4/32; 25 ms: 4/32; 100 ms: 6/32; 400 ms: 3/32. Draws count as half a point. Both colors and all
times stay together in 10,000 cluster resamples; Bonferroni percentile intervals cover the 4-control grid nominally and remain
approximate. The points describe this exact evaluator pair, openings, host, and runtime. No curve is fitted between tested
budgets. This development evidence does not enable production.
